title: Concat (2nd)
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1 \le T \le 1.5 \times 10^5; 2 \le N \le 3 \times 10^5; T,N are integers.; S_i is a string consisting of lowercase English letters with length between 1 and 10^6-1, inclusive.; For a single input, the sum of N does not exceed 3 \times 10^5.; For a single input, the sum of |S_i| does not exceed 10^6.
